responsibility: This file implements the core bitpack variable-length integer codecs shared by GCC’s streaming subsystem. It provides packing and unpacking of unsigned and signed integers into the compact 4-bit-at-a-time bitpack format used inside data-streamer.h helpers, handling sign extension and continuation bits for a bit-oriented stream representation. Unlike the in/out streamer companions, its scope is specifically the primitive bitpack encoding layer rather than file-block management or string-table I/O.
same_name_distinction: Provides the out-of-line primitive variable-length integer bitpack codecs declared by gcc/data-streamer.h, namely packing and unpacking signed and unsigned HOST_WIDE_INT values in the 4-bit continuation format. The header is the broader streaming interface, with bitpack_d, inline fixed-width helpers, and declarations for the separate input/output streamer layers.
